messages.Card payments are processed by the licen: Card payments are processed by the licensed payment institution iyzico with 3D Secure. Card details are not stored on this site. For bank transfers, the donation is confirmed when the money reaches the association account.
messages.A monthly donation is charged to the sam: A monthly donation is charged to the same card every month until you cancel it. You can cancel it at any time from your account page or by writing to us.
messages.The online certificate is sent to the e-: The online certificate is sent to the e-mail address or phone number you give after the payment is confirmed. Please check the names you write on the certificate.
messages.If a donation was made by mistake (wrong: If a donation was made by mistake (wrong amount or a double payment), write to us within 14 days and it is refunded to the same card or account.
messages.Your name and contact details are used t: Your name and contact details are used to record the donation, send the receipt and certificate, and contact you about your donation. See the privacy policy for details.

messages.You can ask what data we hold about you,: You can ask what data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, by writing to us.
